payload.title: Tenant erasure FK sort counts a self-referencing foreign key as a cycle and aborts, so no erased schema can carry a self-FK and the hr organisation-unit parent cannot be made referentially safe; hr goals already declares such a self-FK
evidence: libs/backend-common/src/compliance/tenant-erasure/tenant-erasure-target-executor.ts:554-561 (a self edge adds the table to its own parents and raises its indegree)
libs/backend-common/src/compliance/tenant-erasure/tenant-erasure-target-executor.ts:582-586 (an unsorted table throws 'cannot derive FK-safe delete order')
libs/backend-common/src/database/schema-manager.service.ts:679 (goals is among the hr module tables the executor erases)
payload.rule_violated: Repo rule of root-cause fixes: the erasure guarantee must hold for every valid schema shape, and a tree-shaped self-reference is a valid shape.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-39, release R13.
